full_judgment:
Case under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act seeking preemption as Certificate officer-sharer in respect of the sale dated June 2, 1997 alleging that the opposite party No.3 (seller) has transferred the land measuring 2 kathas of S.A. Plot No. 1432 listed in S.A. Khatian No.I395 corresponding to C.S. Khatian No. 729 to the preemptees (Respondent Nos.1 

 3. The pre-emptees (Respondent Nos. 1 and 2) opposed the prayer for pre-emption  alleging that seller (opposite party No.3) and his brother purchased some land including the land sought to be pre-empted from the father of the pre-emptor by the kabala dated September 18, 1995 and on the basis of the said purchase they got the jama split up and a new khatian being No.1395/8 was opened in their names and as such pre-emptor is not a Co-sharer of the holding land of which purchased by them, that the land sought to be pre-empted is within Dhaka City Corporation and as such pre-emption under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act is not maintainable, that before purchase by the preemptees the land was offered to the pre-emptor but he having had express his inability to purchase the entire land so purchased by the pre-emptees and that pre-emptor also having not offered the prevailing price of the land and later on having had refused to purchase the land at the prevailing price seller-opposite party No.3 transferred the land to the preemptees on June 2, 1997 and made over possession of the land so sold by the Respondent No.3, that Respondent Nos.l and 2 have mutated their names in the Revenue Record and that constructed 6 feet high boundary wall on all sides of the purchased land and that fixed an iron gate at the cost of Tk.35,000/- and that filled up the land by earth at the cost of Tk. 64,000/- and that in obtaining approved plan from the RAJUK incurred cost of Tk. 50,000/- and thus had incurred total cost of Tk. 1,50,000/- towards the development of the land and that pre-emptor had the knowledge about the transfer from the very beginning and also on the subsequent dates when wall on all sides of the land so purchased was constructed and filled up the land earth.
